description: Searches businesses that have chosen to be discoverable on Are We Working, by name or handle. Returns each match's handle, city and state (to tell apart businesses with the same name), and current status. Businesses that are not listed will not appear here, but can still be looked up with get_business_status if you have their exact handle.

query.description: Part of the business name or handle.

name: search_businesses
title: Find a business by name
